'''''Buridda''''' is an [[Italian cuisine|Italian]] [[seafood]] [[soup]] or stew originally from the [[Liguria]] region of [[Italy]].<ref name="Hoffmann"/> Some preparations may be slow-cooked,<ref name="Kafka"/> while others are cooked in a relatively short amount of time (9–10 minutes).<ref name="ALK"/> It has also been described as a [[stew]],<ref name="Kafka"/> or as similar in texture to a stew.<ref name="Hoffmann"/><ref name="ALK"/>
